name: European Robotic Arm
maker: Airbus Defence and Space Netherlands and Astrium
def: Robotic arm attached to the Nauka module of the International Space Station.

excerpt.text:
The European Robotic Arm (ERA) is a robotic arm that is attached to 
the Russian Orbital Segment (ROS) of the International Space Station. Launched to the ISS in July 2021; it is the first robotic arm that is able to work on the Russian Segment of the station.
